sources: 54 Years of Real Estate Data v2 (extended through 2026 YTD), FRED, Realtor.com via FRED; FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis); Realtor.com listing data via FRED; Freddie Mac mortgage rates via FRED.

measures.label: Housing affordability index (100 = median family can just afford)
Down payment as % of annual income
Fed funds change vs prior year (points)

monthly_measures.label: Fed funds change vs 12 months earlier (points)

notes: 2026 annual values are year to date; income and GDP are not yet published for 2026.
Fixes applied vs the original spreadsheet: price and S&P growth formulas, a few mis-referenced cells, and revised 2019-2023 inputs.
White and Jackson counties are not on FRED. Jackson is only inside Cookeville metro.
Nashville metro (CBSA 34980) and Davidson County (FIPS 47037) were added from the same Realtor.com series as Cookeville.
Existing-home sales are not published monthly on FRED before September 2025; use Annual mode for the long history.
Mortgage delinquency is the FRED bank-held single-family rate (quarterly, 1991 onward); no foreclosure series is available on FRED.
